name: x-mod-guard
description: reads every Bash call before it runs and refuses only the destructive floor — rm, a kill by pattern, a git discard or rewrite, a skipped gate, a live seat's close, a raw merge, a stash over a held file, a machine change, a remote delete — each with its safe door and his one tick as the way through; operator-override all turns the floor to warnings, plain rm and the brake aside; every other call runs, with its rewrite or hint; each refusal and pass is kept in its own store as an event and a per-day count
